b1-rendszervaltas-01.title: Communicative Challenge: The Roundtable Talks
b1-rendszervaltas-01.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you what the National Roundtable talks of 1989 were.
b1-rendszervaltas-01.prompt: Tell the official who sat down at the National Roundtable and what the sides agreed about the transition.
cues: Say who sat down at one table
Say what the sides agreed about the transition
b1-rendszervaltas-01.target: A Nemzeti Kerekasztalnál az állampárt és az ellenzék képviselői ültek egy asztalhoz. A felek megállapodtak, hogy az átmenet békés legyen.
b1-rendszervaltas-01.english: At the National Roundtable, representatives of the ruling party and the opposition sat down at one table. The parties agreed that the transition should be peaceful.
b1-rendszervaltas-01.canDo: I can say what the Opposition Roundtable and the National Roundtable were.

b1-rendszervaltas-02.title: Communicative Challenge: The Open Border
b1-rendszervaltas-02.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the opening of the border in 1989.
b1-rendszervaltas-02.prompt: Tell the official when the Pan-European Picnic was and when Hungary announced the border opening.
cues: Say when the border opening was announced
b1-rendszervaltas-02.target: A Páneurópai piknik 1989. augusztus 19-én volt. Szeptember 10-én a kormány bejelentette a határnyitást.
b1-rendszervaltas-02.english: The Pan-European Picnic was on 19 August 1989. On 10 September the government announced the border opening.
b1-rendszervaltas-02.canDo: I can explain what happened on the Austrian border in spring and summer 1989.

b1-rendszervaltas-03.title: Communicative Challenge: The Reburial
b1-rendszervaltas-03.scenario: You are standing on Heroes' Square in Budapest with a guide who asks what happened there in 1989.
b1-rendszervaltas-03.prompt: Tell the guide when Imre Nagy was reburied and how many coffins stood on the steps.
cues: Say how many coffins there were
b1-rendszervaltas-03.target: Nagy Imre újratemetése 1989. június 16-án volt. Hat koporsó állt a Műcsarnok lépcsőin.
b1-rendszervaltas-03.english: The reburial of Imre Nagy was on 16 June 1989. Six coffins stood on the steps of the Műcsarnok.
b1-rendszervaltas-03.canDo: I can say when Imre Nagy was reburied and how many coffins stood on the steps.

b1-rendszervaltas-04.title: Communicative Challenge: The Republic Is Proclaimed
b1-rendszervaltas-04.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks when and by whom the Republic was proclaimed.
b1-rendszervaltas-04.prompt: Tell the official who proclaimed the Republic and on what date.
b1-rendszervaltas-04.target: Szűrös Mátyás 1989. október 23-án kikiáltotta a Magyar Köztársaságot.
b1-rendszervaltas-04.english: Mátyás Szűrös proclaimed the Republic of Hungary on 23 October 1989.
b1-rendszervaltas-04.canDo: I can say when and by whom the Republic was proclaimed.

b1-rendszervaltas-05.title: Communicative Challenge: The First Free Elections
b1-rendszervaltas-05.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you about the elections of 1990.
b1-rendszervaltas-05.prompt: Tell the official when the first free elections were held and which party won the most seats.
cues: Say when the elections were held
Say which party won the most seats
b1-rendszervaltas-05.target: Az első szabad választásokat 1990 tavaszán tartották. Az MDF kapta a legtöbb mandátumot.
b1-rendszervaltas-05.english: The first free elections were held in the spring of 1990. The MDF got the most seats.
b1-rendszervaltas-05.canDo: I can say when the first free elections were held and which party won the most seats.

b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: The Change of Regime in Brief
b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.scenario: At your naturalization interview, the official asks you to sum up the change of regime in two sentences.
b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.prompt: Tell the official when the Republic was proclaimed and when the last Soviet soldier left Hungary.
cues: Say when the Republic was proclaimed
Say when the last Soviet soldier left
b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.target: A Magyar Köztársaságot 1989. október 23-án kiáltották ki. Az utolsó szovjet katona 1991 júniusában elhagyta Magyarországot.
b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.english: The Republic of Hungary was proclaimed on 23 October 1989. The last Soviet soldier left Hungary in June 1991.
b1-rendszervaltas-consolidation.canDo: I can summarise the change of regime: the Roundtable, the border opening, the reburial, the Republic and the elections.
